description: Names as both implementations fold them: trimmed of Unicode White_Space, in NFC, lowercased one code point at a time with no context rules, and in NFC again. The server's title keys (packages/server/src/storage/sqlite/title-keys.ts) and the core's names::folded are held to these cases.
